The '''Tournament Advocate''' is the [[Players Committee]] advocate for organized play: running in-person and online events, setting tournament guidelines, maintaining the Tournament Guide, developing new event formats and keeping records. Early sources call the seat Tournament Support.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref> The current Tournament Advocate is [[Chris Schoenthal]].

To contact the Players Committee, see the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/contact/ Contact page] on starwarsccg.org.
